summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (60/50)

data.turoyo: Komər me d ḥzele u zʕurano yawmo, tre, tloṯo, hamšo koməštaʕe bayn an naʕime, məštahele. <...>
data.translation: Als der Wesir den Knaben ein, zwei, drei, fünf Tage unter den Kindern spielen sah, begehrte er ihn. <...>

rationale: First textual example and new Preterit box; complete complex sentence supplies the implicit desired participant.

summary: 60/50 supplies the first textual example and the missing Preterit box for the existing I.1 begehren. Keep the inherited I classification and məštahele/məštahe forms.

The Preterit has a 3sg.m L-agent ending. The experiencer is the vizier; the desired boy is introduced as the object of seeing and is unexpressed after məštahele. Do not analyse -le as the desired person's object suffix solely from this isolated surface shape.
The preceding seeing clause establishes the stimulus and the following ownership question develops the narrative. The first complete complex sentence is sufficient as an independent quotation.

No further kind or intention of desire is securely established by this verse. The etymological Arabic range does not license new Turoyo senses such as appetite or longing without additional occurrences. No Detransitive or light-verb construction is attested.
Additional examples are needed to establish explicit object coding and the range of desired participants in məštahe; the single omitted-object context does not settle its full valency.
